review_manifest.json.description: Pinned review scope, recommendation, findings, limitations, and write policy; deliberately omits its own hash

blocking_findings: The centered guarantee depends on the represented continuation and is identical for equivalent neural and non-neural representations; it does not identify a neural numerical advantage.

The incremental novelty relative to established risk-averse dynamic programming, occupation formulations, residual transformations, and affine-piece screening is not isolated sharply enough for the scale of the manuscript.
The all-action lower certificate and full risk-envelope control are not executed on the economically relevant continuous-state, continuous-action recursive-risk model.
The new three-state exact diagnostics validate identities but do not demonstrate end-to-end computational advantage after certificate-construction costs are charged.
R92 adds zero fit attempts and zero independent economic rows; the frozen ReLU proposal remains worse than adaptive search in held-out query work.
The prospective economic evidence selects a calibrated Bernstein controller and does not establish strict superiority over fine calibrated ReLU.
The horizon-64 result is conditional on a three-state finite representation and does not establish high-dimensional scalability.
The inherited largest vector kernel and matched comparator tournament remain unimplemented independently, while the adverse four-date vector costs remain.
Energy, monetary calibration, and application-specific computation prices remain external inputs.
The current independent audit is strong for the finite kernel but is not an end-to-end independent reconstruction of the central continuous economic pipeline.
The 267-page cumulative package is disproportionate to the identifiable R92 contribution.
Theory, learning evidence, economic inference, and scalability evidence remain distributed across different model classes.
limitations: This is an advisory repository review, not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
The reviewer inspected the deposited manuscript, proofs, release records, exact diagnostic evidence, and inherited headline tables but did not independently rerun the full repository computation.
The mathematical assessment is a substantive referee check, not a formal proof verification of every inherited theorem.
The report does not treat prescribed rational diagnostics as new economic observations or learning trials.
The review branch modifies no manuscript, revision, main, or prior review file.
positive_findings: R92 is a complete source-bound package and closes the R84 publication-readiness defect.
The reference-centered conditional-risk identity and state-dependent original-optimum certificate are mathematically coherent under the stated assumptions.
The finite penalized risk-occupation representation preserves the infimum-over-actions/supremum-over-risk order and distinguishes risk-distorted from physical occupation.
The strict support cut is oriented safely, retains equality cases, and requires a preverified error set.
The independent finite-kernel checker and adversarial catalogue are unusually strong internal verification evidence.
R92 explicitly preserves negative ReLU evidence and does not count deterministic diagnostics as new fits or economic observations.
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue this cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. Encourage a new focused submission on reference-centered qualification for risk-averse dynamic programming.
required_changes: Develop a new focused paper on reference-centered qualification for risk-averse dynamic programming.
Locate novelty theorem by theorem against the closest risk-DP and occupation-measure results.
Separate general dual-risk theory, finite exact implementation, and continuously enclosed implementation.
Execute the method on the original continuous recursive-risk economic model.
Run matched neural, polynomial, spline, analytic, and conventional representation experiments.
Charge full certificate-construction work and report cross-machine uncertainty.
Demonstrate an all-action lower certificate for a nontrivial continuous action set.
Complete an independent end-to-end large-vector/risk implementation.
Prospectively evaluate the learned component on an independent workload stream.
Design new economic inference around a prespecified economically interpretable margin.
Resolve or explicitly restrict the horizon claim.
Compress the active journal submission drastically.
